problem: The Bedrijfsgeheugen LinkedIn company page had only 12 observed page views in the shown analytics period: 10 desktop and 2 mobile.
rootCause: The system already published and measured social content, but company-page distribution did not have a dedicated closed-loop objective translating page-visit/follower gaps into bounded content actions and revenue learning.
prevention: Never treat company-page posting as sufficient without a distribution objective and measured page/follower outcomes.
Never create a parallel scheduler for LinkedIn company growth.
Never use the personal LinkedIn identity as a commercial bridge to repair company-page distribution.
Never promote page views or follower count to terminal success; connect them to owned-site and revenue outcomes.
Keep duplicate, source, identity and provider-readback gates intact.
